anterior_cranial_contour.melon_arc_radius: Moderate convexity with a broad, smooth curve following the anterior-dorsal cranial boundary.
anterior_cranial_contour.rostrum_aspect_vector: Short, robust rostrum with a low length-to-width ratio extending from the melon inflection point.
anterior_cranial_contour.cranial_inflection_angle: Obtuse interior angle approximately 150 degrees at the transition point between the melon slope and the rostrum.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Multiple pale, irregular speckled markings on the pectoral fin; dark circular indentation or focal mark located posterior to the right ocular region.
other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced dark ocular patch surrounding the eye; pectoral fin shows distinct white mottling on the lateral surface.
